purpose: Add an MP4-transported holographic playback overlay for advanced depth and lighting while preserving the complete VM81, sprite-gradient, and governed-texture authority chain.
governing_rule: The holographic effect is a presentation-only transport and composition layer. The canonical overlay frames must be encoded into MP4, decoded through the playback path, and only the decoded playback frames may be composited over the authoritative texture frames.

forbidden: overlay mutation of VM81 or release state
composition from canonical overlay frames without exercising MP4 playback
frame interpolation that changes the authoritative 60-tick sequence
replacement of the governed texture framebuffer
media generated from a different state sequence than the source texture trace

pipeline: integer screen-light composition over the authoritative texture frames
screenshots, stage comparison, detail crops, and evidence receipt

the overlay MP4 contains exactly 348 ordered frames at 60 fps and 160x144
decoded MP4 playback frames are pixel-exact with canonical overlay frames
